panels.headline: Happy Birthday, Maya!
panels.body: Hope your day is as full of life as your plant collection.
panels.art_direction: Hero composition: a single large potted monstera centered on the panel, drawn in soft line art with pastel green and blush accents. Full-bleed 2D digital illustration, no shadows.

panels.headline: Thinking of you
panels.body: I hope the day opens gently, with good coffee, green trails, and tiny things worth noticing. You have a way of making ordinary mornings feel bright.

panels.headline: From the heart
panels.body: May your birthday be filled with soft sunlight, gentle breezes, and maybe a new leaf or two. You're a great friend, and I'm glad to know someone who can keep both plants and friendships growing. – Jordan
